turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sanibonani. Ukuze abafundi bakuthakasele ukufunda, kufanele uthisha abajwayeze ukubafundela indaba, kakhulukazi uma incwadi isezingeni eliphezulu kunabafundi.
turns.en: Hello. In order for learners to enjoy reading, the teacher must accustom them to reading a story to them, especially if the book is at a higher level than the learners.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukufunda ngokuzwakala kwenza indaba ibe lula, kanti abafundi bezwa nendlela yokwehla nokwenyuka kwezwi okwenziwa uthisha.
turns.en: Reading aloud makes the story easy, and the learners also hear the way of the falling and rising of the voice done by the teacher.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: Let us discuss in detail about reading aloud.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emuva kokuqeda umsebenzi wale module uzokwazi ukuchaza ukubaluleka kokufunda kuzwakale kukathisha efundela abafundi.
turns.en: After finishing the work of this module you will be able to explain the importance of reading aloud of the teacher reading to the learners.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukuchaza okumele kanye nokungamele kwenziwe uma uthisha esebenzisa isu lokufunda kuzwakale.
turns.en: To explain what should and should not be done when the teacher uses the strategy of reading aloud.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukusho kwamaqhinga okwenziwa abafundi bazibandakanye nenkathi uthisha esebenzisa isu lokufunda kuzwakale.
turns.en: To state the strategies of making learners involve themselves while the teacher uses the strategy of reading aloud.
